var status: string;
var status = "ready";
var closed: boolean;
var closed = true;
var top: WindowProxy | null;
var top: null | WindowProxy;
var top: Window | null;
var top: typeof top;
var event: Event | undefined;
type CurrentEvent = Event | undefined;
var event: CurrentEvent;
var event = null as unknown as CurrentEvent;
